goal: Read ColdLion Sales Order received dates for exactly linked caller-readable OrderList lines without exposing raw landing tables.
prohibited_actions: No production or shared-preview writes outside qualified governed workflows.
No changes to source rows, source identities, customer mappings, or production-to-SO link view.
No raw ColdLion table grants; no unauthenticated dates; no earliest-date guesses across Sales Orders.
required_checks: docker exec -i codex-po-no-reuse-01a12aec psql -U postgres -d so_date_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/tests/popdam_sales_order_received_dates.sql
assumptions: created_time already landed and backfilled by #4150 is settled authoritative SO entry/received date in America/New_York.
Existing OrderList contract permits every authenticated staff user to read canonical orders; new reader must preserve that scope.
Each requested line uses only its exact existing ColdLion Sales Order reference; unknown or conflicting timestamps remain NULL.
Application code is updated only after canonical backend is merged and applied.
stop_conditions: Stop on ambiguous matching or source timestamp conflicts; emit NULL rather than choose.
Stop before merge without two independent exact-head approvals and required checks.
Stop before writes without target proof and qualified promotion.
